== Biography ==
William was born before 1757. He is the son of [[Glasgow-1023|Thomas Glasgow]] and [[Mill-357|Janet Mill]].<ref>https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1RG-JPX</ref>

"There is a Baptism of James, son of William and Mary Glasgow on 21 Aug 1799." <ref>https://irelandxo.com/ireland/tyrone/message-board/glasgow-surname</ref>
* Fact: Christening (26 Jun 1757)  Livingston, West Lothian, Scotland
